title: Chicken Shit Oracle
description: A surreal psychedelic illustration on black background features a central dark figure with orange eyes wearing a flower crown, flanked by a black bird on the left and a white dove on the right. Below is a metal bowl containing grapes, peonies, and a blue sign reading 'CHICKEN SHIT ORACLE', while above a gnarled tree trunk with an eye emerges from a swirling staircase into a starry sky with constellations.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic illustration with black background, central dark-skinned figure with glowing orange eyes and flower crown, black bird flying left, white dove flying right, gnarled brown tree trunk with yellow eye growing from swirling grey staircase descending from colorful green and purple clouds, pink chrysanthemums and dripping golden key, metal bowl at bottom filled with red grapes, pink peonies, and blue dripping sign that reads CHICKEN SHIT ORACLE, constellations and bats in starry sky, vibrant detailed symbolic composition
